lead.zh: 从日常使用出发，了解 AI 能做什么、哪里可能出错，再检查资料、隐私与发布要求。无需编程基础。
lead.en: Start from everyday use: learn capabilities and errors, then check sources, privacy and publication requirements. No programming background required.

zh: 说清 AI 的回答为什么可能错，并知道至少两种核对办法
拿到一段 AI 生成的文字或图片，能判断哪些信息必须人工复核
知道哪些内容不要输入公共聊天工具，以及怎么用临时聊天或关闭训练开关
en: Explain why an AI answer can be wrong and know at least two ways to check it
Given AI-generated text or images, identify which claims need human verification
Know what not to paste into a public chat tool, and how to use temporary chat or turn off training

answers.zh: 模型可能补出没有依据的细节。两种核对办法：打开原始资料逐条比对；用独立可靠来源复核关键断言。让同一模型再说一遍不算独立证据。
answers.en: Models may invent unsupported details. Check each claim against the original material and cross-check key claims with an independent reliable source. Repeating the same model response is not independent evidence.

answers.zh: 重点查人名、日期、金额、引文、图中标注和对外承诺。把无法确认的细节删掉或标为未知，不能因为画面或文字自然就直接发布。
answers.en: Check names, dates, amounts, quotations, image labels and external commitments. Remove or label unverified details; natural-looking output is not sufficient for publication.

answers.zh: 先区分公开资料与身份、客户、内部资料。查看当前产品的数据用途、留存和删除说明；临时聊天或训练开关各自控制什么，以该产品说明为准，不把它们当作零留存保证。
answers.en: Separate public material from identity, customer and internal data. Read the product’s current data-use, retention and deletion terms. Temporary chats and training switches are not blanket zero-retention guarantees.

nextTask.zh: 按用途和数据条件挑聊天工具
nextTask.en: Choose chat tools by task and data constraints
